name: gitea-connector
description: Use a self-hosted Gitea instance through a separately configured Gitea MCP app in ChatGPT.

interface.shortDescription: Work with your self-hosted Gitea instance through its MCP app.
interface.longDescription: Adds Gitea workflows for repositories, files, commits, branches, tags, issues, pull requests, reviews, merges and releases. The plugin does not host or launch Gitea or the MCP server itself. It expects a separately configured Gitea MCP app that points to the user's own self-hosted MCP endpoint. Passwords, tokens, secrets, keys, user administration, permissions, runners and webhooks remain excluded from the workflow surface. Writes and destructive actions require confirmation.
defaultPrompt: Show the latest commits in a repository.
Summarize open issues and pull requests.
